meta_data.base_class: Generate an article title about future trends focused on a specific <perspective> - refers to the core angle or analytical dimension adopted when discussing future trends.

tool_template.name: future_article_title_<class>
tool_template.description: Generates a title for an article about future trends focusing on <class>.

year.description: Year in the future to which the article focusing on <class> pertains.

related_elements.description: List of elements related to the <class> topic.

audience.description: The target audience for the article about future trends in <class>.

tone.description: The desired tone for the article, such as 'optimistic', 'analytical', 'neutral' or 'pessimistic'.

word_count.description: Approximate word count for the article title, guiding its length.

region_focus.description: Specific geographic region of focus for the future trends in <class> article, if applicable.

expert_consultation.description: Indicates whether expert opinions are considered in shaping the article title about <class>.
